annotations.title: Add a screen recording to a saved post

description: Attaches a screen recording of a saved post (media_id, a ready video from media_list or the person's library) and starts its study: the cuts, a frame sheet and the spoken words. Use it for TikTok and YouTube saves and for Instagram videos the server couldn't download. Read the result with style_reference_get.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: post_save_recording
